mandatoryCriteria: CSV report generation: GET /api/v1/imports/:importId/report downloads outcome summary and per-row error report
Formula injection neutralization: Cells starting with =, +, -, @ are escaped with leading single quote
Access boundary: Only granted project managers and owners can download report; outsiders receive 404
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: IMP-09 Excel import engine on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: UI components.
